insights: CFG preservation concerns blocks and successor edges; changing a branch condition does not change the CFG but can invalidate branch-dependent value facts. Preserve analysis dependencies at the right semantic granularity.
Specific abandonment overrides abstract preserved sets, including all. Explicit preserve of one analysis removes its abandonment. Intersection unions negative exceptions and intersects preserved IDs.
areAllPreserved and allAnalysesInSetPreserved require an empty abandonment set; stateless preservation still respects explicit abandonment.
Analysis IDs are process-local addresses, with explicit instantiation needed for stable Windows identity. They are not portable content IDs for a knowledge database.
ink_application: Retain exact-source identity for proof and path facts; do not use a CFG-only preservation promise to retain predicate conclusions.
Use complete immutable context for proposed authoring export reuse. A future mutable analysis cache must propagate invalidation through dependencies and keep explicit exceptions.
Keep persistent database hashes separate from process-local analysis identities.
implementation_status: Requirements extracted; no new mutable preservation framework introduced.
